# prestashop don't display Title of product, category meta title, meta description

When new shop is under maintanace mode admin can see FO, but all product, category won't show Title, Meta title, meta description. When you put yourself on list of IP for maintanace it all came back and display correctly. This is nasty thig that I spent 3 hours to fount out on forum that somebody already pos it. But i didn't find this report on Github.
